description: Imani must decide whether to accept Noah for a summer room-share and set the final rent, occupancy, chore, and household rules after a scheduled house meeting with Noah and the current housemate Celeste.

shared_context.S1: Imani's furnished spare bedroom is available for an informal summer room-share from June 1 through August 31.
shared_context.S2: The room includes a bed, desk, and access to the shared kitchen and bathroom.
shared_context.S3: Imani makes the final call on whether to arrange the room-share and sets the verbal terms.
shared_context.S4: At the house meeting, Noah and Celeste will discuss Noah's proposal and Celeste's household requirements with Imani before Imani decides.

PF1.text: Noah can pay exactly $480 per month, will occupy the room on Monday-Friday nights only, and will clean the shared bathroom exactly once per week as part of the deal.

PF2.text: Celeste works overnight shifts and requires quiet from exactly 22:00 to 07:00; she will agree to the room-share only if the incoming tenant is prohibited from having overnight guests.

acceptance_conditions: The room-share must be accepted with Noah selected.
The monthly rent must be exactly 480.
Occupancy must be Monday-Friday nights only, whether written with a hyphen or as Monday through Friday nights only.
Noah must clean the shared bathroom exactly once per week.
A cleaning commitment targeting Noah must be recorded for the weekly bathroom cleaning.
Quiet hours must begin at exactly 22:00 and end at exactly 07:00.
Overnight guests must not be allowed.
Celeste's stated household requirement must be cited after she states it aloud.

content_checks.C3: decisions['occupancy_pattern'] == 'Monday-Friday nights only' or decisions['occupancy_pattern'] == 'Monday through Friday nights only'
content_checks.C5: any(c['type'] == 'cleaning' and c['target'] == 'Noah' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Noah's exact proposal changes the selected tenant to Noah, the rent to 480, the occupancy pattern to Monday-Friday nights, the cleaning frequency to 1 per week, and adds a cleaning commitment targeting Noah.
Celeste's overnight-shift requirement changes the quiet-hour fields to 22 and 7, changes overnight guests to false, and requires PF2 to be disclosed and cited as the basis for those household terms.
